spots.name: Taipei 101

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Taipei 101, formerly known as the Taipei World Financial Center, is a 508-meter, 101-story skyscraper in Taipei, Taiwan. It is owned by the Taipei Financial Center Corporation.

spots.name: National Palace Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The National Palace Museum, also known as Taipei Palace Museum, is a national museum headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan. Founded in Beijing in 1925, the museum was re-established in Shilin, Taipei, in 1965, later expanded with a southern branch in Taibao, Chiayi, in 2015.

spots.name: Legislative Yuan
spots.summary: The Legislative Yuan is the unicameral legislature of the Republic of China (Taiwan), located in Taipei. Since 2008, it is composed of 113 members who serve four-year terms. They are directly elected by voters in the Taiwan Area, through a parallel voting system.

spots.name: Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall
spots.summary: The Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall is a national monument and tourist attraction erected during Taiwan’s martial law period in memory of Chiang Kai-shek, former President of the Republic of China. In recent years, the site has also incorporated remembrance of Taiwan’s martial law period (1949–1987).

spots.name: Control Yuan
spots.summary: The Control Yuan is the supervisory and auditory branch of the government of the Republic of China, both during its time in mainland China and Taiwan.

spots.name: Zhinan Temple

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Zhinan Temple is a Taoist temple on the slopes of Houshan in Wenshan District of Taipei, Taiwan. It was founded in 1882. The temple's main deity is Lü Dongbin, one of the Eight Immortals.

spots.name: National Taiwan Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The National Taiwan Museum, established in 1908, is the oldest museum in Taiwan. It was founded by the colonial government during Taiwan's period of Japanese rule. The museum is located in Zhongzheng District, Taipei.

spots.name: Taipei Zoo
spots.summary: The Taipei Zoo, sometimes referred to as the Muzha Zoo, is a public zoological garden in Wenshan District, Taipei, Taiwan. It is the most famous zoological garden in Taiwan and a leader in conservation, research and education, and recreation.

spots.name: Longshan Temple
spots.summary: Bangka Lungshan Temple is a Taiwanese folk temple in Wanhua District, Taipei, Taiwan. The temple was built in Taipei in 1738 by settlers from Fujian during Qing rule in honor of Guanyin. It served as a place of worship and a gathering place for the Chinese settlers.

spots.name: Taipei Twins

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Taipei Twins is a supertall skyscraper development in Taipei, Taiwan. Scheduled to be completed in 2028, it will include two skyscrapers, the taller of which is 360 metres with 70 floors and the shorter of which is 280 metres with 53 floors.

spots.name: Presidential Office Building

hours.note: Closed Sat, Sun

spots.summary: The Presidential Office Building is the official workplace of the president of the Republic of China on Taiwan. The building, located in the Zhongzheng District in the national capital — Taipei, was designed by architect Uheiji Nagano during the period of Japanese rule of Taiwan (1895–1945).

spots.name: The Sky Taipei

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Sky Taipei is a skyscraper under construction in Taipei, Taiwan. Upon completion, it will be the third-tallest building in Taiwan and the second-tallest in Xinyi Special District and Taipei.

spots.name: 228 Peace Memorial Park
spots.summary: The 228 Peace Memorial Park is a historic site and municipal park located at 3 Ketagalan Boulevard, Zhongzheng District, Taipei, Taiwan.

names.fr: Parc du Mémorial de la Paix 228

photo.author: The original uploader was Allentchang at English Wikipedia.

spots.name: Tao Zhu Yin Yuan

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Tao Zhu Yin Yuan, also known as Agora Garden, is a residential high-rise building located in Xinyi Special District, Xinyi District, Taipei, Taiwan. The building has an architectural height of 93.2 m (306 ft) with 21 floors above ground and four basement levels, with a floor area of 42,335 m2 (455,690 sq ft).

spots.name: Liberty Square
spots.summary: Liberty Square is a public plaza covering over 240,000 square metres (2,600,000 sq ft) in the Zhongzheng District of Taipei, Taiwan. It has served as the city's public gathering place of choice since its completion in the late 1970s.

spots.name: Academia Historica

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: Academia Historica is the national institution of historical research of the Republic of China (Taiwan). Founded in Nanjing in 1947 and re-established in Taiwan in 1957, the institution is under the direct administration of the Office of the President.

spots.name: Xingtian Temple
spots.summary: Hsing-tian Temple is a popular temple in Zhongshan District, Taipei, Taiwan. This temple is devoted to Lord Guan, the Patron Deity of businessmen, military personnel and policeman. This temple is situated on a street corner near the center of the city. Sculptures of dragons feature prominently in this temple's design.

spots.name: Shin Kong Life Tower

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Shin Kong Life Tower, at 51 stories and a height of 245 meters (803.8 ft), is one of Taiwan's earliest skyscrapers. The rose-colored tower topped by a pyramid stands in Zhongzheng District, Taipei, and dates from 1993.

names.zh: 新光人寿保险摩天大楼

spots.name: Taipei Mazu Temple

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Taipei Mazu Temple, formerly known as Monga Xinxing Temple, commonly known as Ximending Tianhou Temple and Ximending Mazu Temple, is a Mazu Temple located in Wanhua District, Taipei, Taiwan. It is dedicated to worshiping Tianhou Mazu.

spots.name: Ciyou Temple

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Ciyou Temple is a prominent Taiwanese folk temple in Songshan District, Taipei, Taiwan. The temple was built in the 18th century and is dedicated to the sea goddess Mazu. It plays a key role in local religious and community life. Each year, on Mazu's birthday, believers visit the temple to pray and celebrate.

spots.name: Taipei Nan Shan Plaza

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Taipei Nan Shan Plaza is a skyscraper in Xinyi Special District, Xinyi, Taipei, Taiwan. It is the third tallest building in Taipei and the fourth tallest building in Taiwan. As of 2019, it is the 146th-tallest building in Asia and 248th-tallest building in the world.

spots.name: Daan Forest Park
spots.summary: Daan Forest Park is a public park near the centre of the Da'an District of Taipei, Taiwan. The park occupies twenty-six hectares and is bordered on its north, south, east, and west by Xinyi Road (信義路), Heping E. Road (和平東路), Jianguo S. Road (建國南路), and Xinsheng S. Road (新生南路), respectively.

spots.name: Cathay Landmark

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Cathay Landmark is a skyscraper located in Xinyi Special District, Xinyi District, Taipei, Taiwan. It is the eighth tallest building in Taiwan and the fourth tallest in Xinyi Special District.

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

names.ja: 台湾キリスト長老教会　済南教会
names.zh: 台灣基督長老教會濟南教會

spots.name: Dalongdong Baoan Temple
spots.summary: Dalongdong Baoan Temple also known as the Taipei Baoan Temple (臺北保安宮) is a Taiwanese Taoist temple built in the Datong District, Taipei, Taiwan.

spots.name: Shandao Temple

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Shandao Temple is a temple in Zhongzheng District, Taipei, Taiwan. It is the largest Buddhist temple in Taipei.

spots.name: Taipei Xia-Hai City God Temple
spots.summary: The Taipei Xia-Hai City God Temple is a temple dedicated to the City God or Cheng Huang Ye (城隍爺) in Taipei, Taiwan.

spots.name: Taipei Botanical Garden
spots.summary: The Taipei Botanical Garden is a botanical garden located in the Nanhai Academy in Zhongzheng District, Taipei, Taiwan. Established in 1896, it covers an area of about 8 hectares and includes over 2,000 plant species.

photo.author: zh:臺北市政府工務局新建工程處

spots.name: Taipei Confucius Temple

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Taipei Confucius Temple is a Confucian temple in Datong District, Taipei, Taiwan.

spots.name: Fubon Life Tower

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Fubon Life Tower is a skyscraper located in Xinyi Special District, Xinyi District, Taipei, Taiwan. It is the third-tallest building in Taipei, and the fifth-tallest in Taiwan.

spots.name: Red House Theater

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Red House Theater, often called Hong Lo Red Play House, Red Theater, Ximen Honglou or Ximen Red House in English, is a historic theater in Ximending, Wanhua District, Taipei, Taiwan. The theater is located at 10 Chengdu Road.

spots.name: Taipei First Girls' High School
spots.summary: Taipei First Girls' High School, is an all-girls senior high school in Zhongzheng District, Taipei, Taiwan. It accepts only the top scorers in the national Comprehensive Assessment Program for Junior High School Students. TFG alumni include researchers, industry leaders, doctors, writers, and politicians.

names.ja: 台北市立第一女子高級中学
names.zh: 台北市立第一女子高级中学

spots.name: Taipei Railway Workshop

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Taipei Railway Workshop was the largest railway workshop of the Taiwan Railways Administration. For decades it manufactured and maintained thousands of railway vehicles. The workshop was established in 1935 to replace the original workshop, the Old Taipei Railway Workshop, which had become inadequate.

photo.author: The original uploader was 台灣少年 at Chinese Wikipedia.

spots.name: Xiangshan
spots.summary: Xiangshan, known in English as Elephant Mountain or Mount Elephant, is a mountain in Xinyi District, Taipei, Taiwan. It is close to the Taipei Metro Xiangshan Station. It is 183 m (600 ft) high and has a hiking trail to the peak, covering a distance of about 1.5 km (0.93 mi). Taipei 101 can be seen from the trail.

spots.name: Asia Plaza Building

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Asia Plaza Building is a 27-story, 101 m (331 ft) skyscraper office building located in Zhongzheng District, Taipei, Taiwan. The building was designed by Taiwanese architect Chu-Yuan Lee. When the building was completed in 1990, it was the tallest in West Taipei, but was surpassed by Shin Kong Life Tower in 1993.

spots.name: Bopiliao
spots.summary: The Bopiliao Historic Block is a historic street in Wanhua, Taipei, Taiwan. The block is made almost completely of one or two story brick buildings, many dating over 200 years ago and was one of the earliest commercial districts in northern Taiwan. The street houses museums, shops, food options, and art exhibitions.

spots.name: Taipei 228 Memorial Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: Commemorates the 228 incident that occurred on February 28, 1947, in which locals revolting against Chinese rule were brutally massacred by the Kuomintang. This incident continues to be a key impetus behind the Taiwan independence movement to this day.

spots.name: National Revolutionary Martyrs' Shrine
spots.summary: The National Revolutionary Martyrs' Shrine is a Martyrs Shrine in Zhongshan District, Taipei, Taiwan, dedicated to the war dead of the Republic of China.

names.fr: Sanctuaire national des martyrs de la révolution

photo.author: No machine-readable author provided. Jiang assumed (based on copyright claims).

spots.name: Taipei Grand Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Taipei Grand Mosque, abbreviated as TGM, and also known as the Taipei Zheng He Mosque is a mosque located in the Da'an District of Taipei City, in Taiwan. It is the largest and oldest mosque in Taiwan and its most important Islamic structure.

spots.name: Taipei Fine Arts Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon, Sat, Sun

spots.summary: The Taipei Fine Arts Museum is a museum in Zhongshan District, Taipei, Taiwan. It is in the Taipei Expo Park. The museum first opened on August 8, 1983, at the former site of the United States Taiwan Defense Command. It was the first museum in Taiwan built for contemporary art exhibitions.

spots.name: Taipei East Gate
spots.summary: The Taipei East Gate is a restored 18th-century gate in Taipei, Taiwan. It gave it name to Dongmen Neighborhood, formerly called Tōmonchō in Japanese period.

spots.name: National Museum of History

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The National Museum of History is located in the Nanhai Academy in Zhongzheng District, Taipei, Taiwan. After the Republic of China government moved to Taiwan, the National Museum of History was the first museum to be established in Taiwan.

spots.name: Taipei North Gate
spots.summary: Taipei North Gate, formally Cheng'en Gate, is a historical gate in Taipei, Taiwan, and a national monument. Constructed in 1884, it is the best-preserved gate of the historical Walls of Taipei.

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Xiansè Temple

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Xiansè Temple, also commonly known as the Wugu King Temple, is a Shennong Temple located in Erchongpu, Wugu Village, Sanchong District, New Taipei City, Taiwan. The temple building has been designated as a cultural asset of New Taipei City and is noted for possessing the largest floral tile wall in northern Taiwan.

spots.name: Chih Shan Yen Hui Chi Temple

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Chih Shan Yen Hui Chi Temple is a temple in Shilin District, Taipei, Taiwan.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Chih Shan Yen Hui Chi Temple

spots.name: Shilin Cixian Temple

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Shilin Cixian Temple is a temple in Taipei, Taiwan. It is located inside the Shilin Night Market. The temple, which is dedicated to the sea goddess Mazu, was established in 1796 and moved to its current location in 1864. Its doors feature artwork painted by the Tainan-born artist Chen Yu-feng in 1960.

spots.name: Lin An Tai Historical House and Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Lin An Tai Historical House and Museum is a museum in Zhongshan District, Taipei, Taiwan.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Lin An Tai Historical House and Museum

spots.name: Republic of China Armed Forces Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Republic of China Armed Forces Museum was a museum located on Guiyang Street in the Zhongzheng District of Taipei, Taiwan. It opened on 31 October 1961, under the administration of the Republic of China Ministry of National Defense Department of History and Translation Office.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Republic of China Armed Forces Museum

spots.name: Far Eastern Plaza
spots.summary: The Far Eastern Plaza is a set of twin skyscrapers located in Daan District, Taipei, Taiwan. The buildings are each 165 m (541 ft) in height, rising 41 floors above the ground.

spots.name: Walsin Lihwa Building

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Walsin Lihwa Building, or Citibank Tower, is a skyscraper office building located in Xinyi Special District, Xinyi District, Taipei, Taiwan. Construction of the building began in 2006 and it was completed in 2009.

spots.name: Linji Huguo Chan Temple

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Linji Huguo Chan Temple is a Buddhist temple located in Zhongshan District of Taipei, Taiwan.

spots.name: Taiwan Garrison Command
spots.summary: The Taiwan Garrison Command was a secret police and national security body under the Republic of China Armed Forces on Taiwan. The agency was established at the end of World War II, and operated throughout the Cold War. It was disbanded on 1 August 1992.

spots.name: Cafe Astoria

hours.note: Closed Fri, Sat

spots.summary: The Cafe Astoria is the first Western-style bakery in Taiwan. It is located in the Zhongzheng District of Taipei, Taiwan, on Wuchang Street across from the City God Temple.

spots.name: National Theater and Concert Hall
spots.summary: The National Theater and National Concert Hall, or together the National Theater and Concert Hall, are twin performing arts venues at Liberty Square in Zhongzheng District, Taipei, Taiwan. Completed in 1987, the landmarks stand on the south and north sides of the square with Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall to the east.

spots.name: Nanhai Academy

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Nanhai Academy is a collection of cultural and educational facilities located on Nanhai Road in the Zhongzheng District of Taipei, Taiwan.

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Railway Department of the Office of the Governor-General of Taiwan is a National Historic Site in Taiwan.

spots.summary: The Bangka Park is a park in Wanhua District, Taipei, Taiwan.

spots.name: Oman TiT

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Oman TiT, or Taipei TiT Tower Square, is a residential skyscraper located in Wanhua District, Taipei, Taiwan. The height of the building is 130 m (430 ft), with a floor area of 26,893 m2 (289,470 sq ft), and it comprises 27 floors above ground, as well as six basement levels.

spots.summary: Taipei’s trade-show venue.

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue

spots.name: Huashan 1914 Creative Park
spots.summary: What is now Huashan 1914 Creative Park opened in 1916 as Taihoku Winery during Japanese rule. It was privately owned winery that produced sake and ginseng wines, and bred moth orchids. The park as it is now was opened in 2005 and features a number of facilities for public use.

names.ja: 崋山1914文化創意産業園区
names.zh: 華山1914文化創意產業園區

spots.name: Hua Shan Cultural and Creative Industry Center
spots.summary: This former brewery has been transformed into a creative space in a park. The exhibitions are well presented and imaginative and the theater performances, while less formal than those at the National Theater, are first rate. The center also has a number of cool cafes - some with outdoor seating - an art movie theater and a number of shops selling innovative crafts.

spots.name: Zhishanyan Cultural and Ecological Garden
spots.summary: A small hill is in the south of Tianmu's Yangming Hospital, and north of the Shuangxi river. The Zhishan Hill (Zhishanyan 芝山岩), one of the oldest archaeological excavation sites in Taiwan. Along the trail, you can see many historic heritages in this hill, the Huiji Temple (惠濟宮), Fortified Gate, small temple and an old camphor tree over 300 years old. Getting there: MRT Zhishan Station (Danshui Lin

spots.name: Bopiliao Old Street
spots.summary: One of the few, and probably best preserved, examples of Qing dynasty architecture in Taipei. The street features historic red brick buildings which have been well restored and are used for a variety of cultural purposes.

spots.name: Ah Chung Mee Soa
spots.summary: You can't miss this shop in Ximending, since crowds of people surround it all day. Standing or sitting, they slurp down hot bowls of mee soa, which are a comfort on cold days. Not quite for the faint-hearted, thin noodles are mixed with a flavorful soup, created from prolonged braising of the (thoroughly washed) large intestines of the pig. Don't forget to add the condiments provided at the side:

spots.name: Cafe Moda Taipei
spots.summary: For people who prefer the new concept of a boutique cafe, the specialty of this place by far are the 100% Organic Guatemalan quality coffee beverages they offer in a cozy ambient mixed with art fashion and great music. A small but fancy terrace is perfect for enjoying beverages on a fresh day. They also have imported beer, wine, tea, juices and other snacks in their menu, including cheese and Ital

spots.name: Happy Fruit Juice Bar

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Happy Fruit Juice Bar is a fresh fruit juice bar decorated with a Greek cafe interior. The store is family owned and run by a mom and four sisters. They serve tea, fresh fruit juice, milk pearl tea and other drinks. It's a great place to grab something cool and refreshing on a hot day. Also, Happy Fruit Juice bar's right beside the Mofo burger joint, so it's a perfect place to get a healthy drink

spots.name: KingSpicy J

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The infamous restaurant known for its spicy noodle challenge, with rare people able to pass. If you are a fan of spicy foods, you will enjoy their spicy noodle, with four levels and the Challenge level. The third level is considered very spicy in other Taiwanese restaurants. Anyone interested in the Challenge level must have tried the fourth level, then challenge the Challenge level the next day.

spots.name: Minimal Cafe

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: This cafe is famous for having many resident cats living inside of it (49, according to the wait staff). In fact, the owner of this cafe loves cats so much, stray ones are adopted, spayed/neutered, then allowed to live in the cafe. Thus, as you drink your beverage, don't be surprised if cats are checking you out. This cafe is indeed clean despite all the cats, and has tasty mid-range priced desser

spots.name: Taipei Brewery
spots.summary: A godsend for the thirsty budget traveler in a city of pricey bars, this is most certainly the cheapest bar in town. This is a great place to find the rare Taiwan Draft Beer, which has a 2-week expiration and usually can only be found in a few restaurants and stores in the same city as the brewery. It's attached to the brewery where Taiwan Beer is made, close to the intersection of Bade and Jiangu

spots.name: 饒河夜市

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: 街名源自合江省饒河縣（今屬黑龍江省），滿語意為「禽獸眾多之地」。位於臺灣臺北市松山區饒河街，為臺北市著名的觀光夜市之一，也是臺灣繼華西街觀光夜市後第二座觀光夜市。饒河街與松山車站一帶舊稱錫口，因基隆河水深、此區又臨河濱，得舟楫之便，逐而成為基隆、宜蘭貨物運至臺北之轉運站，當時商賈雲集、舟船輻輳，極一時之盛。日治時期改名松山，後又因港岸河水淤樍，停泊船隻漸少，再加上八德路拓寬後，饒河街成為次要道路，商業活動大減。政府為了改善當地商家生計，遂於1987年5月11日成立觀光夜市，為臺北市第二條觀光夜市。夜市內容琳琅滿目，除了小吃外，各種日用百貨如服飾、皮鞋與金飾等亦物美價廉，此外還有民俗技藝表演及土產展售等，到現在已經是外國觀光客夜晚來體驗臺灣小吃的重要地點。

names.fr: Marché de nuit de la rue Raohe

spots.name: Shabu Sen

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: This place serves great Japanese/Taiwanese style hot pot dishes. It is a family run restaurant. The environment is clean and refreshing. The owner Ms. Chiu hand picks her ingredients daily from the market. Try the Kobe beef pot and mushroom pot. The price is very reasonable with well selected ingredients. English menu available.

spots.name: Orange Cafe
spots.summary: Pining for a cafe with a backstreet atmosphere and pumping out Indian, Middle Eastern, folk or Floyd type music? Check out Orange Cafe. In addition to coffee/tea etc, they also offer a simple menu that includes vegetarian dishes, and from 22:30 on Friday evening the place comes to life with a fire dance performance on the roof.

spots.name: Mei Guan Yuan

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Located in Ximending Pedestrian Area. This restaurant has served authentic Japanese sushi and sashimi since 1946. (There's another restaurant opposite the road from this with exactly the same name - that's the old location of this restaurant and doesn't serve as good sushi.)

spots.name: Niu Ba Ba (688 Beef Bowl)
spots.summary: The most expensive beef noodle soup to be had in Taiwan. On average this dish costs N$120. Owner Tony Wong has bowls ranging from a few hundred all the way to $10,000. The simple decor belies the intricate process Wong uses to deliver beef noodles for Taipei's foodies.

spots.name: The Brass Monkey

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Great atmosphere with live sports shown on big screens. There’s always something going on - it’s never a regular night. Friendly staffs are ready to serve you with good food and a wide selection of drinks. Go have a dance on their famous Thursday ladies nights.

spots.name: Revolver
spots.summary: Just across the road from the monument to Chiang Kai Shek, this is a bar on the ground floor and a live music venue on the second floor. The indoors part is often full and partrons will stand outside chatting. This bar also has Taiwan Beer Gold Label on tap.

spots.name: Sanxitang Space
spots.summary: Well-hidden slick teahouse/restaurant atop the Palace Museum, which looks more expensive than it is. Most people stop by for a pot of oolong and tiny pastries, but the menu (available in English) also covers dim sum and enough savouries to make a meal.

spots.name: Din Tai Fung

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Famous for its steamed pork dumplings. Worth a detour. Several locations in Taipei and worldwide, but this is the main branch. Gets very crowded even on weekdays so book in advance, or go to other branches such as the one under Taipei 101

spots.name: Addiction Aquatic Development
spots.summary: If you are craving fresh and super affordable seafood, sashimi and sushi, this fish market is the place to indulge. Includes ten different foodie areas, including an outdoor grill joint, sushi bar, and gourmet grocery.

spots.name: Paradise Thai

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Best Thai place in town, better than Thai Town and Spice World. They have Taipei's only micro-brewry built into their restaurant. Great spicy Thai food and cold beer to wash it down. Prices are upper-end, but worth it.

spots.name: Tong Hua Night Market
spots.summary: This night market caters for the more adventurous eaters. The market featuers not only local foods but dozens of exotic delicacies, including inexpensive Malaysian, Japanese and Taiwanese snacks.

spots.name: Jingxing Vegetarian Kitchen
spots.summary: Simple, tasty Chinese vegetarian meals. Choose a set meal from the menu and it is served on a tray. Owner speaks English, and there's a picture menu in English and Chinese.

spots.name: Yongkang Beef Noodle

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: One of the top-twenty beef noodle shops in Taipei. Yongkang Beef Noodle occupies the former location of Lao-Zhang Beef Noodle, which is now located next to it.

spots.summary: Hotel in Taipei, Taiwan
